source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Run MLPerf Inference v4.0 Llama 99.9 high-accuracy Server and compare with MLCommons v4.0.
procedure_facts: The Script field names Llama2-70B 99.9, but the validation text incorrectly asks for BERT.
criteria_facts: Greater than an unspecified official NVIDIA MLPerf score.
source_conflicts: Llama high-accuracy Server conflicts with the BERT validity statement.
`llama` must be proven as the correct harness alias for the pinned Llama2-70B v4.0 implementation.
The generic NVIDIA score lacks a comparable result/system/configuration.
missing_source_information: Exact Llama2-70B model/data/tokenizer and v4.0 harness/configs.
Server latency/throughput, accuracy/compliance and reference comparison rules.

original_test_intent.statement: Run a valid MLPerf Inference v4.0 Llama2-70B 99.9 high-accuracy Server benchmark, prove Llama-specific accuracy and LoadGen/compliance validity, and compare latency-valid Server performance with a signed comparable result.
must_preserve: Llama2-70B 99.9 high accuracy and Server scenario.
Sustained multi-GPU workload and comparable reference.
must_not_infer: BERT, GPT-J, normal accuracy or Offline.
That generic `llama` is valid for any harness.
Comparability with any NVIDIA score or official status for a local run.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly preserves Llama 99.9 Server, detects BERT and Server/Offline ambiguity, and requires licensed artifacts, high-accuracy and LoadGen evidence.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not require proof that the generic `llama` alias selects Llama2-70B in the pinned harness, nor an identified comparable Server result with release-specific language-model latency validity.

related_records: GPT-J and DLRM rows cannot supply this Llama2-70B model/tokenizer, Server latency semantics or accuracy result.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Title, high_accuracy flag and Llama2 Script identify intended Llama2-70B 99.9 Server; BERT is a source defect, while the alias remains untrusted until pinned-harness validation.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Correct the BERT criterion, pin Llama2-70B and prove the harness alias/reference before execution. Then the approved multi-GPU harness workflow is automatable under load/tuning controls.

conditions_present: Title, high_accuracy flag and Script path point toward Llama2-70B 99.9 Server.
missing: Correct criterion, alias proof, model/tokenizer/data licenses and hashes, v4.0 configs, accuracy/compliance workflow, comparable result, thresholds and limits.
provider: Benchmark owner corrects criterion and signs harness/reference.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory GPU/NVLink/NVSwitch/PCIe/NUMA topology, capacity and health; inspect manifests and published result metadata.
prohibited_until_resolved: Artifact download, tuning/container execution, benchmark, log clearing or PASS.
closure_evidence: BERT text corrected and `llama` alias mapped to Llama2-70B for the exact harness.
Pinned licensed stack and all required phases.
Comparable Server result ID plus latency/QPS/accuracy rule.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run MLPerf Inference v4.0 Llama2-70B 99.9 Server
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the approved MLPerf Inference v4.0 Llama2-70B high-accuracy Server configuration, verify Llama-specific 99.9 accuracy plus LoadGen/compliance validity, measure latency-valid Server performance, and compare only with a signed comparable v4.0 result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact multi-GPU SUT system ID, GPU/NVLink/NVSwitch/PCIe/NUMA topology, driver/runtime, container/harness commit, Llama2-70B weights/tokenizer/OpenOrca-derived evaluation data and v4.0 configs. Implementations and aliases are release-specific.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All GPUs/resources declared by the approved configuration; Llama2-70B 99.9 high_accuracy; Server only. BERT, GPT-J, Offline and 99 normal accuracy are excluded.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Corrected source; proof the harness benchmark alias maps to Llama2-70B; pinned v4.0 implementation/container; licensed weights/tokenizer/data hashes; system/user/mlperf configs; accuracy/performance/compliance procedure; approved clocks/power/cooling/fabric settings; comparable result ID; Server QPS/latency, accuracy, validity and health rules.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify artifact/alias/config identity and baseline GPU/fabric health, then run Llama2-70B 99.9 Server accuracy, performance and required compliance phases exactly as the pinned v4.0 implementation specifies. Preserve raw LoadGen/language-model accuracy logs and telemetry. Do not perform the BERT check, Offline mode or an unverified generic alias.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Conflict resolved; artifacts licensed/pinned; all GPUs/fabric links healthy; memory/storage/cooling/power sufficient; no competing load; tuning and recovery approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/config identity; GPU UUID/BDF and NVLink/NVSwitch/PCIe/NUMA topology; driver/runtime/container/harness/model/tokenizer/data hashes; alias proof; exact commands/configs; Llama 99.9 accuracy result; full LoadGen logs with Server latency validity and QPS; required compliance; XID/ECC/fabric/power/thermal/host logs; named comparable reference and normalized comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed v4.0 Llama2-70B 99.9 Server rules and comparable result. Pass requires model-specific 99.9 accuracy, valid LoadGen/compliance, all Server latency constraints, numeric comparison and clean GPU/fabric/host health. BERT or Offline evidence is invalid.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not mix models/accuracy/scenarios/releases; use unlicensed artifacts; trust an unverified alias; copy unmatched tuning; alter clocks/power/fabric without approval; suppress invalidity; clear logs; or call a local run official.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark/data/software/platform owners approve identity, artifacts, reference, tuning and load; a human judges comparability and disposition.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans resolve BERT/alias/reference questions. The Agent executes only the pinned Llama2-70B Server workflow after gates and cannot reinterpret generic names.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on invalidity or GPU/fabric/platform limits, preserve logs, terminate cleanly, restore tuning/services and verify all GPUs/fabric/host health before a fresh approved rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: BERT conflict or alias uncertainty remains; wrong model/scenario/accuracy/release; missing license/config/reference; accuracy/LoadGen/compliance failure; GPU/fabric topology drift; XID/ECC/link/thermal/power/storage/host limit; monitoring/evidence loss.
